title: Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2
authors_zh: Dhruv Nathawani、Shuoyang Ding、Vitaly Lavrukhin、Igor Gitman、Somshubra Majumdar、Evelina Bakhturina、Boris Ginsburg、Jane Polak Scowcroft
paper_type_zh: 多领域、多语言后训练数据集发布与构造披露
best_for_zh: 构建多领域或多语言 SFT 混合数据、审计合成数据来源与许可，或研究发布元数据如何衔接 verifier 和训练阶段的读者
one_line: Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 releases 6,341,414 SFT-style records across technical reasoning, chat, and five target languages, with generator and license metadata but without row-level selection or RL-stage lineage.
Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 发布 6,341,414 条覆盖技术推理、对话和五种目标语言的 SFT 风格记录，并保留生成器与许可字段；但逐条来源、筛选判定、拒绝候选、verifier 输出和训练阶段映射仍未披露。
why: For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, it is both a reusable SFT source and a concrete audit case showing that detailed report-level verifiers and post-training stages do not substitute for record-level provenance, decisions, and run mappings.
inclusion_reason: A versioned multi-domain and multilingual post-training release that makes generator, license, reasoning-mode, and message fields visible while exposing the audit gap between release-level training recipes and row-level selection lineage.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official NVIDIA Hugging Face dataset card is the primary source for this release; the linked arXiv report, NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model (20 August 2025), supplies the surrounding post-training pipeline. Version 2.0 is dated 20 August 2025, and downloading its files requires agreeing to share contact information.

The concrete problem is not only how to assemble a large mixture across mathematics, code, STEM, chat, and languages, but how to make each retained supervision record auditable: where its prompt came from, which model generated the response, which check accepted it, what rights apply, and which training stage consumed it. Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 exposes a large SFT-style record while leaving important source, decision, and run lineage at release level.

A visible row contains uuid, license, generator, version, category, reasoning, and a role/content messages sequence. The nine release splits total 6,341,414 rows. This belongs in Data Construction & Open Release Recipes because it exposes a concrete packaged data object and top-level construction account. It is not a replayable RL corpus: row-level rewards, rejected candidates, verifier outputs, rollout groups, and SFT/RL/DPO/RLHF stage identifiers are not in the published schema.

The Card reaches L4 through the official dataset page, official citation, full report and appendix, and an official NVIDIA data catalogue. Raw Parquet verification, immutable file manifests, row-level provenance, and decontamination evidence remain unresolved.

本卡以 NVIDIA 官方 Hugging Face 数据卡为该发布的主要来源，并用其关联的 arXiv 报告 NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model（2025 年 8 月 20 日）核对更完整的后训练流程。数据版本为 2.0，日期是 2025 年 8 月 20 日；下载文件需要同意共享联系信息。

这里的具体问题不只是如何汇集数学、代码、STEM、对话和多语言数据，还包括如何审计每条保留的监督记录：prompt 来自哪里、哪个模型生成了回答、哪项检查决定接收、适用哪些权利条件，以及记录进入了哪个训练阶段。Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 暴露了大规模 SFT 风格记录，但重要的来源、判定和训练运行 lineage 仍停留在发布级说明。

可见的单条记录包含 uuid、license、generator、version、category、reasoning，以及由 role/content 组成的 messages 序列。九个发布 split 合计 6,341,414 条记录。它属于 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes，因为发布提供了明确的打包数据对象和顶层构造说明；但它不是可重放的 RL 语料：公开 schema 中没有逐条 reward、拒绝候选、verifier 输出、rollout 分组或 SFT/RL/DPO/RLHF 阶段标识。

官方数据页、官方引用、完整报告与附录，以及 NVIDIA 官方数据目录共同支持本卡达到 L4。原始 Parquet 核验、不可变文件清单、逐条来源和去污染证据仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: package 6.34 million synthetic post-training conversations across four technical/chat categories and five target-language splits, while retaining enough row metadata to stratify by generator, license, version, category, and reasoning mode.

| Contract element | Released or documented object | |---|---| | Prompt/task | Public/open-corpus prompt or synthetically generated prompt; upstream source ID is not universal | | Behavior | One or more named DeepSeek/Qwen models produce a message-sequence response, sometimes in reasoning-on and reasoning-off modes | | Trace/answer | messages carries the conversation; reasoning labels the mode; multilingual reasoning traces remain English | | Selection feedback | Release-level quality/complexity and syntax checks, plus domain-specific checks described in the report | | Row metadata | uuid, license, generator, version, category, reasoning | | Missing feedback | Per-row verifier version/input/output/threshold, rejected candidates, scalar reward, and stage/run membership |

The feedback contract is therefore mixed at pipeline level but answer-level in the released object. The paper reports language identification, a lightweight tool-call verification layer, safety guards, IFEval rules, WorkBench database-state comparison, and a Qwen-based reward model in different branches. Those systems can observe target-language identity, tool formatting or environment state, instruction satisfaction, safety judgments, or rollout quality in their own stages. The visible release cannot show which system observed a given row or whether that system accepted it correctly.

The closest predecessor is NVIDIA's Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1, which the report uses for math, science, and code material. Version 2 adds a five-language extension and a different release ledger. The change is breadth plus explicit operational metadata, not a new SFT objective, translation method, verifier, DPO algorithm, or GRPO algorithm.

一句话概括其贡献：把 634 万条合成后训练对话打包为四个技术/对话类别和五个目标语言 split，同时保留足以按生成器、许可、版本、类别与 reasoning mode 分层的逐条元数据。

| 契约要素 | 发布或文档化的对象 | |---|---| | Prompt/任务 | 来自公共/开放语料的 prompt，或合成生成的 prompt；并非每条都有上游来源 ID | | 行为 | 一个或多个具名 DeepSeek/Qwen 模型生成消息序列回答；部分 prompt 同时有 reasoning-on 与 reasoning-off 模式 | | 轨迹/答案 | messages 承载对话，reasoning 标记模式；多语言样本的推理轨迹仍为英语 | | 筛选反馈 | 发布级质量/复杂度与语法检查，以及报告中的领域特定检查 | | 逐条元数据 | uuid、license、generator、version、category、reasoning | | 缺失反馈 | 逐条 verifier 版本/输入/输出/阈值、拒绝候选、标量 reward，以及阶段/运行归属 |

因此，反馈契约在管线层面是 mixed，而发布对象本身仍是 answer-level。报告在不同分支中描述了语言识别、轻量级工具调用验证层、安全 guard、IFEval 规则、WorkBench 数据库状态比较和 Qwen-based reward model。这些系统各自可观察目标语言、工具格式或环境状态、指令满足度、安全判断或 rollout 质量；可见发布却无法说明某条记录经过了哪个系统，也无法证明该系统的接收判定正确。

最接近的前身是 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1，报告中的数学、科学和代码材料沿用了该发布。v2 增加五种语言扩展和新的发布账本。其变化在于覆盖范围和显式操作元数据，而不是新的 SFT 目标、翻译方法、verifier、DPO 算法或 GRPO 算法。

title: Method
方法
html:
The evidence supports the following reconstructable pipeline, with an explicit boundary between the released dataset and the broader model-training report.

  1. Inputs. Extract prompts from public/open corpora or synthesize new prompts. The dataset card says quality and complexity are required, but does not give a universal per-row source ID, source revision, or prompt-generation specification.
  2. Prompt filtering. Remove inconsistent prompts, prompts whose answers are easy to guess, and prompts with invalid syntax. Exact filter models, thresholds, ordering, and rejection counts are unknown.
  3. Response generation. Generate synthetic responses with DeepSeek-R1-0528, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-AWQ, Qwen3-30B-A3B, or Qwen3-235B-A22B. The official generator totals overlap because multiple models may contribute to one record; decoding temperature, seeds, retry policy, and candidate budget are unknown.
  4. Multilingual construction. Translate existing English post-training data line by line, skip non-translatable material such as code, enforce a bracketed extraction format, and reject off-target outputs with language identification. Prompts and responses target Japanese, German, Italian, Spanish, or French, while reasoning traces remain English (report Section 3.1, PDF p.14).
  5. Other report-level checks. Tool-use simulations assign Qwen3-235B-A22B the User-Agent, Assistant-Agent, and API-Server-Agent roles; parameter checks and a lightweight rule layer retain only successful trajectories. Safety data use guard filtering. These mechanisms are described in the report but are not attached as row-level fields in this release.
  6. Outputs. Write Parquet rows with uuid, license, generator, version, category, reasoning, and messages, organized into nine splits under an SFT configuration.
  7. Training use. The public object is suitable for SFT. The report separately describes three SFT stages: a full mixture packed to about 128k tokens plus roughly 10% reasoning-stripped examples; a non-concatenated tool-calling stage; and a long-context/truncated-reasoning stage. It then describes IFEval RL, on-policy WorkBench DPO pairs, and HelpSteer3 GRPO/RLHF (report Section 3.2, PDF p.15). The release provides no row-to-stage or row-to-run crosswalk.

Reproduction must therefore pin dataset revision, file hashes, all subset manifests, source and generator terms, and the exact report/model version. It must also supply the undisclosed prompt revisions, decoding settings, filter implementations, rejected candidates, and training-stage mixture; the official page alone cannot replay those decisions.

现有证据可支持下列可重建流程，同时必须明确区分已发布数据集与范围更广的模型训练报告。

  1. 输入。 从公共/开放语料抽取 prompt，或合成新 prompt。数据卡要求质量和复杂度，但没有提供通用的逐条来源 ID、来源版本或 prompt 生成规范。
  2. Prompt 过滤。 删除不一致、答案容易猜出或语法无效的 prompt。具体过滤模型、阈值、顺序和拒绝数量均为 unknown。
  3. 回答生成。 使用 DeepSeek-R1-0528、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-AWQ、Qwen3-30B-A3B 或 Qwen3-235B-A22B 生成合成回答。官方 generator 总数会重叠，因为多个模型可能共同贡献一条记录；解码温度、seed、重试策略和候选预算均未披露。
  4. 多语言构造。 逐行翻译既有英语后训练数据，跳过代码等不可翻译内容，强制使用括号格式抽取，并用语言识别拒绝非目标语言输出。prompt 与回答分别面向日语、德语、意大利语、西班牙语或法语，但推理轨迹仍为英语（报告第 3.1 节，PDF 第 14 页）。
  5. 其他报告级检查。 工具使用模拟让 Qwen3-235B-A22B 分别扮演 User-Agent、Assistant-Agent 和 API-Server-Agent；参数检查与轻量级规则层只保留成功轨迹。安全数据使用 guard 过滤。这些机制出现在报告中，却没有作为本发布的逐条字段保存。
  6. 输出。 将 uuid、license、generator、version、category、reasoning 与 messages 写入 Parquet，并在 SFT 配置下组织为九个 split。
  7. 训练用途。 公开对象适用于 SFT。报告另述三个 SFT 阶段：完整混合数据被打包为约 128k token，并加入约 10% 去除推理轨迹的样本；不做拼接的工具调用阶段；长上下文/截断推理阶段。随后又有 IFEval RL、基于 on-policy WorkBench 正负样本的 DPO，以及 HelpSteer3 上的 GRPO/RLHF（报告第 3.2 节，PDF 第 15 页）。发布没有逐条记录到训练阶段或运行的 crosswalk。

因此，复现必须固定数据版本、文件 hash、所有子集清单、来源与生成器条款，以及准确的报告/模型版本；还需要补齐未披露的 prompt 版本、解码设置、过滤实现、拒绝候选和阶段混合权重。仅凭官方页面无法重放这些决策。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release-level evidence is exact and directly relevant to the data object. The official card reports 239,467 math, 175,000 code, 355,000 STEM, 627,720 chat, 975,202 Japanese, 1,015,314 German, 1,016,503 Italian, 935,704 Spanish, and 1,001,504 French rows. These nine values sum to 6,341,414. The same card identifies version 2.0, release date 20 August 2025, Parquet format, an SFT configuration, contact-information gating, and a repository-level CC-BY-4.0 label.

The generator ledger is not a row ledger: DeepSeek-R1-0528 is listed for 5,713,694 samples; Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct for 3,928,913; Qwen3-30B-A3B for 627,720; Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-AWQ for 1,015,314; and Qwen3-235B-A22B for 627,720. The card explicitly warns that multiple models may produce one record. The sum therefore must not be interpreted as dataset size or one-teacher attribution.

The linked report gives a different accounting surface: approximately 80 billion SFT prompt-response tokens and Table 7 domain counts of 1.5M math, 1.1M coding, 2.0M science, 400K tool-calling, 1.5M conversational, 2K safety, and 5.0M multilingual samples (Section 3.1, PDF pp.13-14). Those figures describe the model's SFT stages, not a row-for-row manifest of this 6.34M release; no official reconciliation is supplied.

For model behavior, Table 8 reports the aligned 12B checkpoint at 85.42 AIME-2024, 76.25 AIME-2025, 97.75 MATH-500, 64.48 GPQA-Diamond, 70.79 LiveCodeBench, 89.81 IFEval, 66.98 BFCL v3, 83.36 RULER@128k, and 74 ArenaHard. The evaluation averages 16 runs for AIME, four for MATH-500/GPQA/LiveCodeBench/IFEval, and one for the remaining listed benchmarks (Section 3.3, PDF p.16). These scores concern a checkpoint trained through multiple data and optimization stages. They do not isolate this release or prove row-level correctness, provenance, decontamination, licensing, or verifier quality.

No independent reproduction, per-row verifier audit, rejection-rate table, or immutable file checksum ledger was found in the confirmed official artifacts. Artifact existence and model performance are therefore stronger claims than artifact completeness or data quality.

发布级证据精确且直接对应数据对象。官方数据卡报告：math 239,467 条、code 175,000 条、STEM 355,000 条、chat 627,720 条、日语 975,202 条、德语 1,015,314 条、意大利语 1,016,503 条、西班牙语 935,704 条、法语 1,001,504 条，九项合计 6,341,414。该页还标明版本 2.0、发布日期 2025 年 8 月 20 日、Parquet 格式、SFT 配置、联系信息门控和仓库级 CC-BY-4.0 标签。

Generator 账本不是逐条记录账本：DeepSeek-R1-0528 对应 5,713,694 个样本，Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 为 3,928,913，Qwen3-30B-A3B 为 627,720，Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-AWQ 为 1,015,314，Qwen3-235B-A22B 为 627,720。数据卡明确提醒，一个记录可能由多个模型共同生成。因此，这些数不能相加为数据集规模，也不能用于推断每条记录的唯一 teacher。

关联报告给出了另一套统计口径：约 800 亿个 SFT prompt-response token；表 7 分别列出 1.5M math、1.1M coding、2.0M science、400K tool-calling、1.5M conversational、2K safety 和 5.0M multilingual 样本（第 3.1 节，PDF 第 13-14 页）。这些数字描述模型的 SFT 阶段，而不是本次 634 万条发布的逐行 manifest；官方没有提供二者的对齐表。

模型行为方面，表 8 报告 12B 对齐 checkpoint 在 AIME-2024、AIME-2025、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench、IFEval、BFCL v3、RULER@128k 和 ArenaHard 上分别为 85.42、76.25、97.75、64.48、70.79、89.81、66.98、83.36 和 74。评测对 AIME 平均 16 次，对 MATH-500/GPQA/LiveCodeBench/IFEval 平均 4 次，其余所列 benchmark 各运行 1 次（第 3.3 节，PDF 第 16 页）。这些分数属于经过多种数据和优化阶段训练的 checkpoint，不能隔离本发布的作用，也不能证明逐条正确性、来源、去污染、许可或 verifier 质量。

已确认的官方产物中没有独立复现、逐条 verifier 审计、拒绝率表或不可变文件 checksum 账本。因此，artifact 存在和模型表现是比 artifact 完整性或数据质量更强、也更有限的主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Compared with a mixture described only by aggregate domain totals, this release makes a useful operational change: one versioned artifact spans technical reasoning, chat, and five target languages while retaining uuid, license, generator, version, category, reasoning, and messages. Those fields permit category filtering, reasoning-mode analysis, generator stratification, multilingual audits, and initial rights triage without parsing a model report.

Relative to Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1, the linked report and v2 card emphasize the five-language extension and English-only reasoning traces. That language-asymmetric object is a concrete design choice that reusers can test rather than an undocumented side effect.

The release does not introduce SFT, synthetic response generation, translation, quality filtering, syntax checking, tool simulation, DPO, GRPO, or reward modeling. It also does not expose a complete preference or RL record: rollout groups, paired choices, rewards, log probabilities, rejected alternatives, environment states, optimizer state, and stage-to-row lineage are absent.

Its direction signal for reasoning-data research is therefore not a claim of a new algorithm. It makes visible the gap between a richly described report-level pipeline and a much thinner reusable row contract. Before reuse, researchers must verify whether the published rows correspond to the report's stage counts, whether generator is complete and interpretable, whether language-asymmetric traces transfer safely, and whether source and license metadata are sufficient for the intended use.

与只报告领域汇总数量的混合数据相比，本发布做出的实质变化是：一个带版本的 artifact 同时覆盖技术推理、对话和五种目标语言，并保留 uuid、license、generator、version、category、reasoning 与 messages。这些字段使读者无需解析模型报告，就能按类别过滤、分析 reasoning mode、按生成器分层、审计多语言结构并初步筛查权利条件。

相较 Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1，关联报告与 v2 数据卡强调五种语言扩展和仅保留英语推理轨迹。这个语言不对称的数据对象是可被复用者直接测试的设计选择，而不是隐藏的副作用。

该发布没有提出 SFT、合成回答生成、翻译、质量过滤、语法检查、工具模拟、DPO、GRPO 或 reward modeling。它也没有暴露完整的偏好或 RL 记录：rollout 分组、成对选择、reward、log probability、拒绝候选、环境状态、optimizer 状态，以及训练阶段到记录的 lineage 均缺失。

因此，它对 reasoning-data 研究的方向信号不是新算法主张，而是把“文档丰富的报告级管线”与“字段更薄的可复用逐条契约”之间的差距变得可见。复用前必须核验：发布记录与报告阶段数量如何对应、generator 是否完整且可解释、语言不对称轨迹能否安全迁移，以及来源和许可元数据能否满足预期用途。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Access and versioning: raw Parquet files are contact-gated. A reproducible snapshot needs exact repository revision, file names, row counts, hashes, and configuration manifests; these were not verifiable without access.
  • Accounting mismatch: the nine release splits total 6,341,414 rows, whereas the report's Table 7 and 80B-token statement describe a larger SFT-stage accounting surface. No record-level reconciliation is published.
  • Provenance and contamination: rows lack universal upstream source IDs/revisions and transformation histories. Exact deduplication and benchmark-overlap procedures, matches, removals, and false-negative analysis are unknown.
  • Selection observability: the visible schema has no verifier identity/version, score, threshold, failure code, or rejected candidate. Release-level checks are not per-item correctness certificates.
  • Generator ambiguity: generator totals overlap because multiple models may contribute to one record. Without candidate and transformation logs, generator cannot recover a unique teacher or selection path.
  • Multilingual asymmetry: target-language prompts and responses retain English reasoning traces. This can introduce translation artifacts, code-switching, hidden English-teacher style, and unequal supervision quality across languages; this risk is a curator inference, not a measured failure rate.
  • Rights chain: repository-level CC-BY-4.0 coexists with per-row ODC-BY or CC-BY-SA labels and Qwen/DeepSeek model terms. A label alone does not supply upstream URLs, revisions, required attribution, or a compatibility decision for downstream distribution.
  • RL over-reading: the report describes IFEval RL, WorkBench DPO, and GRPO/RLHF, but the release lacks stage membership, rollout groups, rewards, log probabilities, preference pairs, and optimizer state. Treating visible rows as replayable RL data would be unsupported.
  • Verifier failure risk: rule checks may false-accept superficially compliant but wrong outputs; model judges and guards may carry bias or false rejections; database-state success may miss undesirable action paths. No calibration or retained-failure audit is released.
  • Evaluation scope: benchmark improvements measure checkpoint behavior under the paper's settings. They do not establish data correctness, safety, provenance, contamination control, license compatibility, or independent reproducibility.

• 访问与版本： 原始 Parquet 受联系信息门控。可复现快照需要准确的仓库 revision、文件名、行数、hash 和配置清单；在未获访问权限时无法核实这些信息。
  • 统计口径不一致： 九个发布 split 合计 6,341,414 行，而报告表 7 和 800 亿 token 的说法描述更大的 SFT 阶段统计面。官方没有发布逐条对齐关系。
  • 来源与污染： 记录缺少通用的上游来源 ID/版本和变换历史。精确的去重与 benchmark 重叠流程、命中记录、删除结果和 false-negative 分析均为 unknown。
  • 筛选不可观测： 可见 schema 没有 verifier 身份/版本、分数、阈值、失败码或拒绝候选。发布级检查不是逐条正确性证书。
  • 生成器歧义： 多个模型可能共同贡献一条记录，因此 generator 数量会重叠。没有候选与变换日志时，generator 无法恢复唯一 teacher 或筛选路径。
  • 多语言不对称： 目标语言 prompt 与回答仍搭配英语推理轨迹。这可能引入翻译伪影、code-switching、隐藏的英语 teacher 风格和语言间监督质量不均；这是 curator inference，而不是论文测得的失败率。
  • 权利链： 仓库级 CC-BY-4.0 与逐条 ODC-BY、CC-BY-SA 标签以及 Qwen/DeepSeek 模型条款并存。单个标签不能提供上游 URL、版本、必需署名，也不能自动给出下游发布的兼容性结论。
  • 过度解读 RL： 报告描述了 IFEval RL、WorkBench DPO 和 GRPO/RLHF，但发布缺少阶段归属、rollout 分组、reward、log probability、偏好对和 optimizer 状态。把可见记录视为可重放 RL 数据没有证据支持。
  • Verifier 失败风险： 规则检查可能 false-accept 表面合规但实质错误的输出；模型 judge 与 guard 可能有偏差或错误拒绝；数据库状态成功也可能忽略不良动作路径。发布没有校准或失败保留审计。
  • 评测范围： benchmark 提升衡量的是论文设置下的 checkpoint 行为，不能证明数据正确性、安全性、来源、污染控制、许可兼容性或独立可复现性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, this artifact is useful both as a conditional SFT source and as a release-metadata audit case.

  • Conditional SFT reuse: first pin an immutable revision and file hashes; then inspect row schema and counts, stratify by category/language/reasoning mode/generator, validate message structure, deduplicate prompts, run target-benchmark overlap checks, and resolve every source and generator term. The contact gate and aggregate CC-BY-4.0 label do not remove these duties.
  • Multilingual supervision study: compare English-only reasoning with target-language reasoning or no exposed reasoning at matched prompts. Measure language identification, answer correctness, code-switching, and transfer separately for Japanese, German, Italian, Spanish, and French.
  • Filtering audit: reconstruct quality, complexity, syntax, language, tool, and safety checks as separate components. Preserve candidates that pass and fail each check, then estimate false accepts/false rejects rather than treating retained rows as ground truth.
  • Lineage design: extend each row with immutable source ID/revision, transformation steps, exact generator checkpoint, prompt/chat template, decoding parameters, candidate group, every verifier result, rejection reason, and intended training stage/weight.
  • Release reconciliation: crosswalk the 6,341,414-row artifact against the report's Table 7 domain totals, approximately 80B SFT tokens, and exact checkpoints. Keep dataset rows, training mixtures, policy rollouts, and evaluation records as separate ledgers.

Reuse class: conditionally suitable for SFT after access, revision, rights, provenance, quality, and contamination checks; strong as an audit/reference example for release metadata; blocked for direct RL/DPO/RLHF replay because the necessary outcomes, candidate groups, rewards, environments, and run mappings are absent. It should not be reused as a clean evaluation set without a separate overlap analysis.

对于 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track，本 artifact 既是有条件可用的 SFT 来源，也是审计发布元数据的案例。

  • 有条件的 SFT 复用： 先固定不可变 revision 和文件 hash；再核对逐条 schema 与数量，按类别/语言/reasoning mode/generator 分层，验证消息结构，做 prompt 去重和目标 benchmark 重叠检查，并解决每项来源与生成器条款。联系信息门控和汇总 CC-BY-4.0 标签都不能免除这些工作。
  • 多语言监督研究： 在 prompt 匹配的条件下，比较英语推理、目标语言推理和不暴露推理三种形式；对日语、德语、意大利语、西班牙语和法语分别测量语言识别、答案正确性、code-switching 与迁移效果。
  • 过滤审计： 将质量、复杂度、语法、语言、工具和安全检查重建为独立组件；保留通过和未通过各检查的候选，并估计 false accept/false reject，而不是把最终保留记录直接当作 ground truth。
  • Lineage 设计： 为每条记录补充不可变来源 ID/版本、变换步骤、准确 generator checkpoint、prompt/chat template、解码参数、候选分组、全部 verifier 结果、拒绝原因，以及预期训练阶段/权重。
  • 发布对账： 将 6,341,414 条 artifact 与报告表 7 的领域总数、约 800 亿 SFT token 和确切 checkpoint 建立 crosswalk；分别维护数据集记录、训练混合、policy rollout 与评测记录的账本。

复用等级：在完成访问、版本、权利、来源、质量和污染检查后，可有条件用于 SFT；适合作为发布元数据的审计/参考案例；由于缺少结果、候选分组、reward、环境和运行映射，不能直接重放 RL/DPO/RLHF。若没有独立重叠分析，也不应把它当作干净的 evaluation set。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the official dataset card first: its nine split counts total 6,341,414 rows and define the released object more directly than the model report's training tables.
  • Keep the report's approximately 80B SFT tokens and Table 7 domain counts separate from the public row ledger; no row-level reconciliation is published.
  • Treat generator totals as overlapping contribution counts, not unique rows or unique-teacher assignments.
  • Multilingual prompts and answers target five languages, but reasoning traces stay in English; preserve and audit this asymmetry.
  • Read report Sections 3.1-3.2 for pipeline context, while remembering that their tool, guard, IFEval, WorkBench, and reward-model decisions are absent from the row schema.
  • Before reuse, pin raw files and hashes and resolve source, decontamination, verifier, rejected-candidate, rights, and stage-mapping unknowns.

• 先读官方数据卡：九个 split 合计 6,341,414 条记录，它比模型报告的训练表更直接地定义了发布对象。
  • 将报告中约 800 亿 SFT token 和表 7 领域数量与公开逐条账本分开；官方没有发布逐条对齐关系。
  • 把 generator 数量视为可重叠的贡献计数，而不是唯一记录数或唯一 teacher 分配。
  • 多语言 prompt 与回答面向五种语言，但推理轨迹仍为英语；复用时应保留并审计这种不对称。
  • 阅读报告第 3.1-3.2 节以理解管线背景，同时记住其中的工具、guard、IFEval、WorkBench 和 reward-model 决策没有进入逐条 schema。
  • 复用前固定原始文件与 hash，并解决来源、去污染、verifier、拒绝候选、权利和训练阶段映射等 unknown。
